patches.reason: Legacy bug (creator report): helldate3.groovy sets block = "pantiesend" at the end of the first panties branch, but no case "pantiesend" exists and the switch has no default, so the while (!endReached) loop spun forever there (V2 explorer: TSR037). Evident intent: every other branch of helldate3 ends at "end1", which says goodbye and ends the script; the patch goes to "end1".
